:::{#thm-var-diff-logodds}

#### Variance of the estimated difference in log-odds

In a [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression),
let $\eb$ be the [maximum likelihood estimate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) of $\vb$,
let $\Sigma \eqdef \Covt(\eb)$ be its covariance matrix,
and let $\diffvx \eqdef \vx - \vxs$ be the difference between two covariate patterns.
Then the variance of the estimated difference in log-odds $\edifflogodds = \dprodf{\diffvx}{\eb}$ is:

$$\Var{\edifflogodds} = \tp{\diffvx}\Sigma(\diffvx)$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-se-diff-logodds, worked in @sol-se-diff-logodds.

:::
